svg.title: From Named Accounts to Repeat Shippers
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-repeat-shipper-cohort-funnel; chart type: funnel; title: From Named Accounts to Repeat Shippers; subtitle: Track one acquisition cohort through five nested account states.; chapter number: 6; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Illustrative 180-day cohort of 200 distinct shipper accounts; each later stage is a subset of the prior stage. Counts are planning assumptions, not measured benchmarks or load counts. The canonical first-deal planning range remains 2–6 months.; caption: 200 targeted accounts produce 10 repeat shippers in this illustration: 5% end-to-end conversion, with no implied revenue until actual load frequency and invoice values are established.; stages: label: Named target accounts; value: 200 lane-matched commercial shipper accounts; numeric value: 200.0; detail: Select accounts with recurring lanes, compatible equipment requirements, reachable transportation buyers, and an identifiable entity responsible for payment.; label: Qualified buyer conversations; value: 80 accounts; 40% of targeted accounts; numeric value: 80.0; detail: Document shipment cadence, incumbent service gaps, procurement process, payment terms, and an accessible buyer with authority to sponsor a trial.; label: Documented quoting opportunities; value: 40 accounts; 50% of qualified conversations; numeric value: 40.0; detail: Receive actual origin, destination, commodity, weight, equipment, and timing requirements; exclude speculative rate checks without a credible shipment opportunity.; label: Completed first-load customers; value: 20 accounts; 50% of quoting opportunities; numeric value: 20.0; detail: Count only customers with a delivered first shipment and an issued invoice; a signed agreement without a completed load does not enter this stage.; label: Repeat-load customers; value: 10 accounts; 50% of first-load customers; numeric value: 10.0; detail: Require a second completed shipment within the cohort window and no overdue undisputed invoice before treating the account as an active repeat relationship.

text.title: From Named Accounts to Repeat Shippers
text.tspan: From Named Accounts to Repeat Shippers

circle.title: label: Named target accounts; value: 200 lane-matched commercial shipper accounts; numeric value: 200.0; detail: Select accounts with recurring lanes, compatible equipment requirements, reachable transportation buyers, and an identifiable entity responsible for payment.

label: Qualified buyer conversations; value: 80 accounts; 40% of targeted accounts; numeric value: 80.0; detail: Document shipment cadence, incumbent service gaps, procurement process, payment terms, and an accessible buyer with authority to sponsor a trial.

label: Documented quoting opportunities; value: 40 accounts; 50% of qualified conversations; numeric value: 40.0; detail: Receive actual origin, destination, commodity, weight, equipment, and timing requirements; exclude speculative rate checks without a credible shipment opportunity.

label: Completed first-load customers; value: 20 accounts; 50% of quoting opportunities; numeric value: 20.0; detail: Count only customers with a delivered first shipment and an issued invoice; a signed agreement without a completed load does not enter this stage.

label: Repeat-load customers; value: 10 accounts; 50% of first-load customers; numeric value: 10.0; detail: Require a second completed shipment within the cohort window and no overdue undisputed invoice before treating the account as an active repeat relationship.

text.title: Assumptions: Illustrative 180-day cohort of 200 distinct shipper accounts; each later stage is a subset of the prior stage. Counts are planning assumptions, not measured benchmarks or load counts. The canonical first-deal planning range remains 2–6 months.
text.tspan: Assumptions: Illustrative 180-day cohort of 200 distinct shipper accounts; each later stage is a subset of the prior stage. Counts
